name: Quince
message: How now, spirit! Whither wander you?

name: Katherine
message: No, sir, God forbid, but ashamed to kiss.

name: Bernardo
message: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.

name: Lady Brit
message: I don't buy it. Get thee gone, you sniveling suck-up.

name: Ophelia
message: (...She still doesn't trust me. I wonder if there's something more I can do. Maybe I could find someone to help me.)

name: Ophelia
message: My father has a saying for times like this. 'To thine own self be true.'

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: I am, in theory, above gossip... what would you like to say?
